// tweets_for_ai is already a STRINGIFIED JSON array
const tweetsJsonString = $json.tweets_for_ai;

// Build OpenAI payload with enhanced prompt
const body = {
  model: "gpt-4o-mini",
  temperature: 0.1,
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content:
        "You are a high-precision sentiment analysis engine designed to detect NEGATIVE tweets about the gambling platform Gamdom.\n\n" +

        "You will receive a JSON array of tweets mentioning Gamdom (@gamdom, @GamdomHowly, @pnrGamdom, or @Gamdom).\n\n" +

        "Your task is to extract ONLY tweets that indicate NEGATIVE RISK, COMPLAINTS, OR LOSS OF TRUST toward Gamdom AS A PLATFORM.\n\n" +

        "IMPORTANT: NEGATIVE does NOT require anger, insults, or emotional language.\n" +
        "Calm, factual, or polite statements about money, bans, withdrawals, or platform behavior ARE NEGATIVE.\n\n" +

        "ALWAYS FLAG AS NEGATIVE IF A TWEET MENTIONS ANY OF THE FOLLOWING:\n\n" +

        "FINANCIAL / WITHDRAWAL ISSUES:\n" +
        "- Withdrawals blocked, delayed, disabled, or stuck\n" +
        "- Funds locked, frozen, or inaccessible\n" +
        "- Wallet liquidity issues or inability to process withdrawals\n" +
        "- Withdrawal-only mode that does not work\n" +
        "- Any amount (even small amounts) that cannot be withdrawn\n\n" +

        "KYC / VERIFICATION PROBLEMS:\n" +
        "- KYC requested and then account banned or restricted\n" +
        "- Level 2 verification delays or failures\n" +
        "- KYC completed but funds still locked\n" +
        "- Documents pending for days, weeks, or months\n\n" +

        "ACCOUNT ACCESS ISSUES:\n" +
        "- Account banned or suspended without clear reason\n" +
        "- Restrictions applied immediately after withdrawal attempts\n" +
        "- Account disabled while funds remain inside\n" +
        "- Unequal or discriminatory treatment between players\n\n" +

        "SUPPORT / COMMUNICATION FAILURES:\n" +
        "- Support delays that prevent access to funds\n" +
        "- Promised timelines missed by support\n" +
        "- Escalation to Twitter due to unresolved issues\n\n" +

        "PLATFORM TRUST & RELIABILITY ISSUES:\n" +
        "- Claims Gamdom cannot or will not pay users\n" +
        "- Comparisons showing Gamdom failing against competitors\n" +
        "- Statements implying loss of trust or disappointment in the platform\n\n" +

        "CRITICAL DETECTION PRINCIPLES:\n" +
        "1. Tone does NOT matter â€” polite complaints are still NEGATIVE\n" +
        "2. Real money + problem = NEGATIVE\n" +
        "3. Time delays (hours/days/months) = NEGATIVE\n" +
        "4. Process failures (KYC â†’ ban, withdrawal mode â†’ failure) = NEGATIVE\n\n" +

        "EXAMPLES THAT MUST BE FLAGGED:\n" +
        "\"They asked for KYC to withdraw and then banned my account\"\n" +
        "\"$45k stuck for 48 hours after completing KYC\"\n" +
        "\"Gamdom wallet had no funds to process my withdrawal\"\n" +
        "\"Account set to withdrawal-only mode but withdrawals donâ€™t work\"\n" +
        "\"Support is too slow and I canâ€™t access my money\"\n\n" +

        "DO NOT FLAG AS NEGATIVE:\n" +
        "- Giveaway entries or promotional posts\n" +
        "- Gambling luck complaints not blaming Gamdom\n" +
        "- Bonus or free spin requests\n" +
        "- Neutral questions without describing a problem\n\n" +

        "OUTPUT FORMAT RULES:\n" +
        "- Return ONLY valid JSON\n" +
        "- NO markdown\n" +
        "- NO explanations outside JSON\n" +
        "- ALWAYS return an object in this exact format:\n" +
        "{ \"negative_tweets\": [] }\n\n" +

        "For EACH negative tweet, return:\n" +
        "- tweet_id\n" +
        "- tweet_text\n" +
        "- author_username\n" +
        "- author_name\n" +
        "- created_at\n" +
        "- reason (clear explanation of why this is negative toward Gamdom)\n\n" +

        "FINAL RULE:\n" +
        "If a tweet describes money access problems, withdrawal issues, KYC delays, account restrictions, " +
        "support failures, unfair treatment, or platform reliability issues â€” FLAG IT AS NEGATIVE regardless of tone."
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content:
        "Analyze the following tweets array and return ONLY tweets that are negative toward Gamdom as a platform.\n\n" +
        tweetsJsonString
    }
  ]
};

// Return ONE clean JSON object for HTTP Request node
return [
  {
    json: body
  }
];
